name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 46 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 46 hours starting 2026-02-16, at wavelengths from 0.81 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
